name: openbb_index_constituents
description:
Meant to list the members of a stock index (S&P 500, NASDAQ, Dow Jones) through OpenBB.
Returns: {index, constituents: [...]} or {index, error}.
Inputs (* required): index* (sp500, nasdaq or dowjones; default sp500); provider (code default fmp; the schema says yfinance).
OpenBB 4.6 has no obb.index.sp500, and obb.index.constituents takes symbol rather than index, so this tool currently returns an error object; use fmp_sp500_constituents, fmp_nasdaq_constituents or fmp_dowjones_constituents instead.
Example: {"index": "sp500"}
